1.o: November, 1986. Second-year student at Yunagi university, Touya Fuji, is having a nightmare one morning. The dream is about his girlfriend and newly-cast idol, Yuki Morikawa.

2.t: Do you believe in long-plotted encounters?
2.o: Yuki stops by music star-turned-studio president, Eiji Ogata's home, after finishing shooting a TV shoot. At the same time, Touya is paid a surprise visit by his childhood friend, and college classmate, Haruka Kawashima.

3.t: Hand in hand, shoulder to shoulder, back to back, and then... we don't have to take off our clothes.
3.o: Rina offers Touya a part time job "helping out her manager." Touya cancels his job as a tutor, more out of a desire to see Yuki than interest in the job itself.

4.t: Sometimes you feel like you understand someone beyond imagination. A lot of times it's the opposite though.
4.o: Thanks to Rina's intervention, Touya and Yuki are able to go on their first date in a long time.

5.t: It's not only those who are close to you that get in your way. The less you know someone, the harsher you are.
5.o: Yuki's manager tells Touya that their thoughtless actions are perfect bait for celebrity gossip magazines and subtly hints that he should break up with Yuki.

6.t: A good way to forget your troubles...How about getting involved in somebody else's?
6.o: Misaki's script was accepted by the Drama Club, but the Drama Club president, with whom she has a past, is forcing her to make all the props and clothes herself. The time limit is two weeks and Touya happily offers to help Misaki.

7.t: A mental image is something that needs constant building up. It crumbles easily.
7.o: Yuki successfully finishes the recording of her debut single, "White Album." Meanwhile, Misaki is staying at Touya's father's house, as the two of them work to make the props and clothes.

8.t: The less time you have, the more you can do. The more you do. Of course, love is no exception.
8.o: A mentally imbalanced Haruka is wandering the streets, and is harassed by two men. She's saved by Mana, who happens to pass by. Touya is spending his days working with Misaki, the work getting more and more frantic as the deadline approaches...

9.t: Memories don't need to be prettied up like a play. The minute you say them aloud, they're all lies.
9.o: The day of the big rehersal for the drama club play, Touya and Misaki finish the props and clothes. However, Tamaru insists that they change the color to "monotone."

10.t: Sumo Wrestling by yourself isn't lonely just because you don't have a partner. The eyes of the audience sting, too.
10.o: The injured Misaki spends a night at the hopsital, and finds herself rapidly growing closer with Akira, who stayed with her the whole time. Due to a secret agreement between the head of M&M Music, Itsuki Kanzaki, and Ogata Productions' Eiji, Rina is forced to change the venue she was going to perform her concert in.

11.t: Time won't take care of the feelings building up in your heart. It just labels them "forgotten."
11.o: Eiji reveals his secret agreement for the Christmas concert: a match to see who can bring in more fans. Rina interrogates Yayoi about a letter she discovered in the office trash can. Mana has gotten close enough to Haruka that the two of them are going biking together. Meanwhile, Touya is troubled over his feelings for Yuki, and reveals them to Yayoi...

12.t: “Restriction. Deception. Deprivation. Giving. Waiting is more trying than all of these.”
12.o: Touya reveals his relationship with Yayoi to Rina but she takes him to task, telling him it’s too dangerous. The next day, Rina goes to wait for Touya in the VIP room at the end of his work day at Echoes, but Touya leaves with Yayoi in her car.

13.t: Even though the glass was tipped over, didn't you notice? Not even one drop of water remained.
13.o: At long last, the Christmas concert begins, full of emotions and feelings. Touya shows up at the Yunagi Koukaidou for Yuki's concert.

14.t: I've never been able to tune properly. I keep thinking that it could sound better.
14.o: After the Christmas Eve concert, Touya's father collapses, due to a longstanding condition, and is hospitalized. The next day, Yuki goes to visit him but missed Touya on his way out. Itsuki Kanzaki, after blowing off the Christmas Eve concert, is scolded, and the missing M&M agency's star singer, Menou Akiyama, is discovered. Eiji then stands before a painting after winning the spoils of war in his "mobilization value" bet.

15.t: The things you can't find will destroy what's around you. Because they're not there, there's nothing that can be done.
15.o: After Eiji stops giving Yuki her lesson, she decides to stop by and visit Touya's father in the hospital. On New Years Eve, Yuki goes to Touya's apartment. The two bring in the new year kissing. This is how 1987 begins...

16.t: When I think back to my childhood, the embarrassment I feel is agonizing. Compared to that...
16.o: Touya's father planned to spend the New Year's holiday at home, but his condition suddenly worsens and he has to return to the hospital. Touya is saddened and disappointed in his father's condition. A few days later, a meeting is held at Ogata Productions. It is about the Venus Festival, a musical competition for young female singers which is held every February. Rina has never been given a chance to enter it before... The rule is set that each production company may only send one group or singer to the competition. Rina, realizing what was going on in Eiji's mind, suddenly declares she is goi

17.t: There are lies one wants exposed. There are truths one does not want to believe in. There is one of each.
17.o: Upon declaring independence from Ogata Productions, Rina leaves. Yuki chases her in the rain and desperately begs her to return. Rina has made up her mind and will not be convinced to go back. After regaining her composure, Yuki reminisces about recording White Album with Rina... While this is going on, Eiji is paid a visit by Itsuki and a consultant sent to regain a picture that wasn't theirs to give away. However, this is really just one of Itsuki's plots... Eiji offers his Tri-Sad studio, but the price won't cover the painting...So what will Eiji offer to pay for it...?

18.t: Don't bugs have it too easy? They shut themselves away in their shells, and yet they're claustrophobic.
18.o: It is revealed, at a press conference, that Rina will be transferring to Itsuki Kanzaki's rival agency, M&MM. In the same press conference, Sakuradan announces that they are disbanding and that their vice-leader, Sarii, will be going solo. Yuki visits Touya's father in the hospital by herself. The two begin to discuss his son... Touya goes to the dressing room at the TV station to catch Rina after she finishes her last gig for Ogata Productions. Rina tries to put up a strong front, but melts in Touya's arms when he puts them around her. "Kiss me, Fuji-kun."

19.t: They usually say you move on to the next when you're bored with what you have. Although, I usually seem  to be bored well before
19.o: Rina informs Yuki directly that her and Touya just kissed after showing up at her dressing room. To muddy the waters further, Touya joins Rina at M&MM as her assistant. After this devastating blow, Yuki tries to distract herself from the pain by biting her wrist as she hears Rina's painful words. The next week, as Rina and Touya begin their job at M&MM, Itsuki orders the two of them to sit in on Menou's recording session. At the studio, Touya makes the connection that Menou is the girl he met outside the Yunagi Koukaidou on the night of the Christmas Eve concert. Menou seems to care less about

20.t: Love is not rational. The lovers who said this were poets, critics, and philosophers.
20.o: Touya returns to his hometown, only to find Menou waiting for him. She's acting like she owns the place when a staffmember from the agency comes to retrieve her. Eiji determines that the picture of a girl he received from Itsuki is a forgery and continues his search for the real one. Eiji is having delusions about what is really in the pictures, but Yuki sets him straight. Rina, meanwhile, has a nearly empty schedule. With Touya at her side, she undergoes a bunch of voluntary training. And, of course, Touya and Yayoi's affair continues on...

21.t: I want to return to the fork in the road. I should have gone right instead. I've regretted every second since then.
21.o: A shadow looms over Touya and everyone. Rina's ex-manager, Hiraragi, is secretly filming Rina outside when Maruta calls out to him. Hiraragi was plotting his revenge against the Ogata Productions team, when Maruta thrusts himself in the mix. Touya is tutoring Mana in her room when her mother, Itsuki, happens to catch him in there. Mana learns that Touya is working for Rina while being friends with Yuki. This enrages Mana and she runs out of the house.

22.t: Worried you're not a good speaker? Try talking with your eyes. It'll make you want to talk in no time.
22.o: Touya goes all the way to Haruka's mountain house, in search of Mana, after she ran away from home. There he sees Haruka, getting back on the horse and practicing tennis again. Tamaru suddenly approaches Misaki and asks her to write an article for him. In return, he will not release the secret photos he has of Touya and Yayoi. Menou offers to save the day. She aggrees to stage a scandal to take the place of Touya's...

23.t: We hope to catch colds in order to be nursed and fed. We don't even imagine the pain we're about to endure.
23.o: Yuki spends all her free time practicing for her appearance in the Venus festival. At the same time, Menou is chosen to represent M&MM. Hearing this news, Rina stops by the recording studio where Menou and Natsuko are making their album. Touya's dreams of the distant past, while in the hospital... He sees a young Yuki there. He then passes away, never waking from this dream. While Misaki helps go through his things, to display at the wake, Touya tells stories of his father. He then bursts into tears and embraces Misaki. "This is only for today."

24.t: Night does nothing for you. The sun is what makes things fade.
24.o: Menou's scandal makes it into the public eye. At the same time, Eiji is accused of possessing forgeries andtax evasion. Menou stays in Touya's apartment to avoid the scandal. Touya cannot remember when or where he first met her. At the same time, Rina declares she will be taking Menou's place in the Venus festival. However, she will be singing Menou's songs and not her own. Yuki visits Eiji in his secrte hiding place and tries to console him, after losing everything. The two of them embrace. Yuki closes her eyes against his chest, and...

25.t: It's somebody else's fault. Not mine. It's all somebody's else's fault. And not at all...
25.o: "I'll always be your goddess." Menou is revealed to be the first goddess, and it's shown that her relationship to Touya goes far further back than anyone suspected.

26.t: And thus we sit together now, and all night long we have not stirred.
26.o: "The few months before Yuki moved were the first point of connection between us." Yuki's past, and the reason why she became an idol, are revealed.

Luke Rutherford is your average teenager – until his dead father's best friend, Rupert Galvin, turns up. Galvin has come to tell Luke his secret destiny: he's the real-life great-grandson of Abraham Van Helsing, the vampire hunter in Bram Stoker's Dracula. Luke is set to inherit the family mantle as a warrior against the supernatural entities swarming the earth.

Unfortunately, powerful Half-Life, Gladiolus Thrip (Mackenzie Crook) is standing in his way.

2.o:
Six-year-old Madge might think her sister has been ‘taken up to heaven by an angel’ but Galvin suspects otherwise. Everything points to half-life involvement and he thinks it’s the perfect project for Luke.

A visit to zombie priest, Father Simeon (guest star Richard Wilson) confirms Galvin’s suspicions. Gilgamel is no angel – he’s a demon, a travesty demon, a Type 9 entity attracted by the odour of sanctity. Can Luke rise to the challenge?

3.o:
Galvin lets his emotions get the better of him when his wife's murderer, Mr Tibbs, arrives in town. Hell-bent on revenge and with no regard for his own safety, Galvin arms himself to the teeth and embarks on what amounts to little more than a suicide mission.

The problem is, his thirst for vengeance leads him straight into rat-man's trap, putting more than his own life at risk.

4.o: When a bad boy vampire arrives on the scene and Mina starts behaving strangely, Galvin gets suspicious. Mina confesses that Quincey is back. He has come for her – he wants her to give in to her half-blood heritage. Galvin reassures her that he, of all people, understands – but they both know that sentiment has no place in the smiting game. One thing’s for sure - a battle of epic proportions is in the offing…

5.o: Mina and Galvin's investigation of a murder lead them to believe that Luke is in danger. Whilst Luke is lying low Mina starts having visions of a winged beast; Galvin and Ruby are concerned that Luke's new love interest is a low life who had taken the form of a beautiful female to trick its prey.

6.o: Luke becomes haunted by dreams about the car crash that killed his father and Galvin's connection to it. A visit to a psychic convinces him his godfather is not the man he seems and, with Gladiolus Thrip back on the scene and showing an unhealthy interest in Luke's past, the vampire-fighting duo look set to be torn apart.

1.o: يعيش جمعان وابنه فراج وزوجته روضة معاً وتتميز حياتهم بالفقر إلى حد ما، لكن ليس هذا فقط ما يقلقهم، فهم يتعرضون للعديد من الأمور الغريبة الخارجة عن الطبيعة التي تثير رعبهم.

2.o: بعد الإلحاح الشديد من والده، يقوم فراج بربطه بالسلاسل، ولكن يحدث أمر غاية في الغرابة يصدم فراج. لاحقاً، يأخذ فراج والده إلى طبيب نفسي.

3.o: يستمر الحوار بين جمعان والرجل الأبيض وفلوة التي تتلبس جمعان في حين يصل أمر من المحكمة بإخلاء منزل جمعان لعدم تمكنه من دفع الإيجار. لاحقاً، تذهب الجنية فلوة إلى بيت جمعان على هيئة امرأة جميلة وتقابل روضة.

4.o: يمرض خالد مرضاً شديداً. وفي هذه الأثناء، تتصاعد الأحداث ويدخل فراج في ورطة بعد أن يطلب منه سليم إخلاء البيت.

5.o: تصاب أسرة فراج بفاجعة وحزن شديدين، وفي هذه الأثناء، يقوم سليم بإخراج جميع أثاث وممتلكات فراج وجمعان من البيت ويرميها في الشارع.

6.o: يتلقى فراج اتصالا من أبي سعود يطلب منه الذهاب إلى المعلم مرزوق. أما فلوة فتظهر مجدداً على هيئة قطة في بيت عبد الرحمن.

7.o: يذهب جمعان إلى بيت أمه المهجور وهناك يشاهد أمراً يصدمه، ولاحقاً تخبره فلوة بأن خالد لم يمت وبأن عليه أن ينبش قبره ليتأكد بنفسه.

8.o: يدخل فراج في نقاش حاد مع والده بعد أن علم بنبشه قبر خالد. ولاحقاً، يصاب عبد الرحمن بإصابات بالغة.

9.o: على الرغم من الإصابة البليغة التي تعرض لها رأس عبد الرحمن إلا أنه يكتشف بأن الجرح قد شفي تماما الأمر الذي يثير دهشة الطبيب، أما فراج وبعد خروجه من السجن تساوره الشكوك حول زوجته روضه حول وجود علاقة بينها وبين صديقه عبد الرحمن.

10.o: يطلق فراج زوجته أم خالد ويترك المنزل ويتوارى عن الأنظار، أما طليقته فتعيش في ظروف صعبة وتتعرض لمعاملة سيئة من قبل نزيلات دار رعاية الأرامل والمطلقات، بينما يقنع جمعان عبد الرحمن ببيع المنزل الذي يقطن فيه واستثمار المال في شراء محطة للوقود.

11.o: يكتشف جمعان وعبد الرحمن بأن محطة الوقود التي قاما بشرائها تقع في منطقة معزولة وموحشة في منتصف الصحراء، بينما يخبرهما أحد عمال المحطة بوجود حيوانات مفترسة في المكان ومسكون بالجن الأمر الذي دب الرعب في قلب عبد الرحمن.

12.o: يتمكن الرجل الأبيض الذي يمتلك قدرات خارقة من نقل عبد الرحمن والعامل في المحطة إلى بيتهما بسرعة كبيرة، بينما يُنزل عبد الرحمن من السيارة ويتركه وحيداً في الصحراء ليواجه خطر الموت والعطش.

13.o: يتفاجأ الشخص الذي قام باستئجار منزل جمعان القديم بحدوث أشياء غريبة داخل المنزل حيث أخذ الأثاث يتطاير في الهواء وسرعان ما يصاب بالذعر الشديد، أما طلال فيطلب من السائق فراج ترك منزل شقيقته بشاير.

14.o: تقوم بشاير بدعوة فراج لتناول الإفطار، أما الأخير فينتابه حزناً شديداً بسبب تصرفاتها وزواجهما الذي يعتبر بمثابة حبر على ورق، بينما يذهب جمعان وعبد الرحمن وعامل المحطة إلى موقع المحطة في الصحراء ليبحثوا عن الكنز.

15.o: تتغير حالة أم سالم التي تقيم في دار الرعاية، وتتحسن معاملتها مع روضة بعد أن كانت تهينها وتضربها وذلك بفضل الجنية فلوة التي وعدت روضة بتأديب أم سالم، وبينما ينهمك جمعان والسوداني وعبد الرحمن في حفر الصخور بحثا عن الذهب، يكتشفون مفاجأة صادمة.

16.o: يعثر جمعان وعبد الرحمن على تمثال أثناء عملية التنقيب، وبعد أن تأكدهما بأنه من الذهب الخالص، يستعينان بالطبيب راشد الذي قدمهم بدوره إلى خبير يدعى غيث، ويقرران بيعه بمبلغ 700 ألف ريال.

17.o: خلال انهماك عبد الرحمن وجمعان في البحث عن باقي الكنوز بالقرب من المحطة، تظهر الجنية فلوة وتهمس في أذن جمعان وتطلب منه مغادرة المكان، أما أم سالم فتخرج من دار الرعاية وتتصل بفراج.

18.o: يظهر جمعة السوداني من جديد ويصبح شكله مخيفا ومتوحشا ويحاول الانتقام من جمعان وعبد الرحمن بعد حصولهما على الكنز وتركه وحيدا في الحفرة، أما أم سالم فتحاول الانتقام من فراج.

19.o: تتجسد الجنية فلوة بصورة فتاة في غاية الجمال وتقود سيارة فارهة وتنطلق إلى مكتب سليم الذي يعمل في مجال العقارات، أما التغير المفاجئ في حياة عبد الرحمن وجمعان بعد عثورهما على الكنز فيثير شكوك سالم اتجاههما.

20.o: ما زالت بشاير مصرة على أن يبقى زواجها من فراج حبر على ورق، والشرطة تحقق مع د. راشد حول اختفاء غيث الغامض.

21.o: يتجادل راشد مع فلوة التي تعلمه بحقائق ومعلومات صادمة، ويزيد إصراره على حل لغز اختفاء غيث برغم التهديد. في نفس الوقت، يخبر جمعان لعبد الرحمن عن مدى حبه لدانة.

22.o: تحاول فلوة معرفة سر خالد، ويقف محقق الشرطة حائراً أمام لغز غيث، أما عبد الرحمن فيوافق على الزواج من روضة بعد إلحاح من جمعان.

23.o: يقوم المحقق بسجن راشد بسبب ظنه بأنه يحاول خداع مسار التحقيق، وتتواجه فلوة مع والدها الأبيض بسبب حبها لجمعان ورغبتها بالزواج منه، إلا أن الأبيض يقف ضد فكرة الزواج.

24.o: يدخل الأبيض المستشفى بسبب فلوة بعد أن اكتشف حقيقتها وبأنها جنية حقيقية، ويخبر راشد بكل شيء. أما بشاير فتفتح الخزنة بعد خروج فراج من الغرفة فترى المسدس وأدوات القتل، وتقف مذهولة أمام هذا المشهد.

1.o: The legitimate seventh daughter of the Luo family, Luo Yining, has been raised in a villa since childhood. For Old Madam Luo's 60th birthday, she requests Yining to return to Luo Residence to attend the celebration. However, almost no one in the family welcomes her return. Later, someone tries to frame Luo Yining by using faulty fireworks, but Luo Shenyuan from the Luo family happens to witness the incident.

2.o: Yining brings Qing Qu to take a look at Shenyuan's scar and use acupuncture to see if his hand has recovered. Qing Qu finds something strange about the exploded fireworks and it is related to Madam Qiao's Bilian Court.

3.o: Yining gathers everyone at Muxi Hall to interrogate Yue and Madam Lv. She reveals that it was Madam Qiao who ordered Madam Lv to bring up the topic, ultimately forcing Madam Qiao to give up her authority to manage the household.

4.o: Shenyuan and Shao An catch Ying sneaking into Haitang House and adding some powder to Yining's incense burner. Later, Shenyuan returns the sachet of powder to Haitang House, where Yining sees his silhouette. This makes Yining start to suspect his Third Brother.

5.o: Chengzhang is furious when he finds out that Yining has given his grandfather's paintings to Shenyuan. He instructs Butler Bai to retrieve it. Shenyuan, not wanting to trouble Yining any further, tells Shao An to cut off contact with anyone from Haitang House.

6.o: Yining is kidnapped by Fifth Master Qiao and his men in a small forest. At the same time, Li Yinglong is meeting with Lu Jiaxue in the same forest. Qi An leads his men to rescue Li Yinglong, while Shen Yuan fights Lu Jiaxue one-on-one.

7.o: In the cave, Yining carefully helps Shenyuan with his bandages, and the two have a heartfelt conversation. Although Shenyuan doesn't explicitly say what he is up to, he promises Yining that he will never harm the Luo family or hurt her.

8.o: Yining throws a birthday party for Shenyuan, inviting only Yixiu and Lin Mao. Shenyuan feels touched, and the four of them drink and play games together happily.

9.o: Yining is afraid that Cheng Lang is sent by Lu Jiaxue to probe her and quickly burns the papercutting she made. Meanwhile, Cheng Lang goes to attend a lesson at Tingfeng Court to learn the status of every young master in Luo Residence.

10.o: Yining is knocked unconscious. When she wakes, she finds the performer Lian Qing trying to take advantage of her. He even claims the sash as their love token. Yining tries to run from him.

11.o: Yining suffers from a high fever and the physician's treatments don't work for her. Shenyuan recalls Physician Du's advice and begs Old Madam to let him try.

12.o: Yining found out that there was something wrong with the tonic that her mother drank. So, she questions the physician who treated her. However, she can't find any further clues.

13.o: Shenyuan is accompanying Hairu and Yining to the country estate when they unexpectedly encounter a landslide. The carriage ropes tangle around Shenyuan's leg, nearly pulling him off the cliff.

14.o: Lu Jiaxue arrives at Luo Residence to search for a wanted criminal. Shenyuan stands up against him but is pulled aside and flogged. Yining overcomes her fears and steps forward to intervene.

15.o: During the Literary Competition Feast, Yining rushes to the stage to play 'Unarmored Conqueror' with Yi Yu to save the situation. Hearing the familiar melody, Lu Jiaxue rushes forward to ask Yining why she chose this song.

16.o: Yining asks Madam Zheng about her mother's death, and Madam Zheng tells her about Gu Minglan's situation before her death. She mentions that her father had a great fight with Gu Minglan before she passed away. Yining becomes suspicious of the tea leaves.

17.o: During the family banquet, Old Madam Luo formally announces Shenyuan's inclusion in the family registry, making him rightfully and officially a legitimate son of the Luo family, recorded under Lin Hairu's name.

18.o: Yixiu secretly comes to visit Lin Mao, but is spotted by Lin Hairu. To keep his elder sister from worrying, Lin Mao pretends he has no interest in Yixiu and even says some harsh things, which Yixiu happens to overhear.

19.o: Lu Jiaxue points out Yining is Mei. Mei argues that Mei was her servant who was dead. Lu Jiaxue cannot accept the fact that Mei is dead.

20.o: Shenyuan persuades Old Madam Luo to hand over the testimony from back then. After reading it, Shenyuan finally realizes that the mastermind behind it all is the influential court minister, Wang Yuan.

21.o: The Emperor has issued a decree for Wang Yuan to reopen the case of Chen Daoyan, and Shenyuan has decided to enlist Duke Ying to counter Wang Yuan.

22.o: Shenyuan does his best to fight the kidnappers. Thankfully, Shao An and the others appear in time to save them. Yining takes care of Shenyuan all day and cries. She prays Shenyuan can wake up soon.

23.o: When Lin Hairu hosts a banquet for Shenyuan, Lu Jiaxue arrives uninvited, ostensibly to offer his congratulations but actually to test the waters, hoping to persuade Luo Shenyuan to give up any hope of overturning the case.

24.o: Shenyuan wants to rescue Chen Daoyan, but Lu Jiaxue holds Chen Daoyan hostage and threatens Shenyuan to surrender.

25.o: Yining talks about her history with Lu Jiaxue. Shen Yuan feels bad for Yining and embraces her impulsively.

26.o: Lin Mao wants to elope with Yixiu, but Yining stops them. Yining brings forth a witness from the day of the incident and embarrasses Chen Lan in front of everyone. Despite this, Chen Lan remains firmly opposed to Lin Mao and Yixiu being together.

27.o: In a desperate move, Shenyuan asks Luo Chengzhang to write a guarantee and boldly rushes to the magistrate's office to demand the release of Luo Yining. Lu Jiaxue takes the lead and forcibly carries away Luo Yining, leading to a confrontation among the three in the jail.

28.o: Madam Zheng finally shares the truth from all those years ago, and Yining is able to confirm her real identity. Shenyuan swears that no matter what happens in the future, he will always protect Yining.

29.o: Yining thinks she can't make her own decision no matter where she goes and decides to move to Yanrong Pavilion. She is going to be independent and self-sufficient with her own abilities.

30.o: Shenyuan becomes the top scholar and is appointed Senior Judge of Supreme Court. Yining congratulates him, but Shenyuan feels that Yining has been avoiding him lately.

31.o: Great Madam Wei hopes that Yining will close down Yanrong Pavilion and stop showing herself in public for the sake of status and rank. Yining is unwilling to do so, and Wei Ting ends up saying something hurtful. Wei Ling steps in to teach Wei Ting a lesson.

32.o: Wei Ling finds a teacher for Yining, who happens to be Luo Shenyuan. Shen Yuan teaches Yining how to write, and both feel a bit uncomfortable.

33.o: Shenyuan finally confirms Yining's feelings for him and happily tells her he will propose to her.

34.o: At the Flower Festival, the young ladies gather in the flower hall for the feast, but they suddenly begin to experience itching. Shen Jiarou accuses the floral essence Yining gave them as the cause.

35.o: Yang Ling is imprisoned. Lu Jiaxue purposely lets Luo Shenyuan whip Yang Ling to test him and Luo Shenyuan hits him badly. Later, Lu Jiaxue brings Yining into the prison and lets her see how cruel Shenyuan is to make her give up on Shenyuan.

36.o: Yining goes to the temple to offer a prayer. She is being assassinated by a man in black. Yining realizes that the person is Shenyuan. Lu Jiaxue arrives in time and they fight. Shenyuan's crossbow accidentally hurts Yining.

37.o: Lin Mao officially asks the Luo family for Yixiu's hand in marriage. He vows to devote himself to Yixiu alone, leaving her flustered and shy. Meanwhile, Duke Ying's army has been ambushed. Their fate is uncertain.

38.o: Luo Shenyuan finally clears the injustice for his teacher and senior brother. Yining blames Shen Yuan for keeping it from her. Luo Shenyuan returns to the prison to negotiate with Wang Yuan, while the Supreme Court starts arresting Wang Yuan's accomplices.

39.o: The Luo family is bustling with preparations for Yining's wedding. Meanwhile, Wang Yuan remains adamant about the existence of the agreement. Lu Jiaxue seeks to make a deal with him.

40.o: Lu Jiaxue set a trap to capture Luo Shenyuan and caused a fire at Haitang House. Everyone in Luo Residence thinks Luo Yining perished in the fire. Luo Shenyuan breaks down when he rushes to the scene of the fire.
